name: Tourbillon
summary: A rotating cage that holds the balance and the escapement and turns once each minute, so that gravity acts on the balance in every position.
how: Mount the balance wheel, the hairspring and the escapement in one light cage.
Turn the cage once each minute with the fourth wheel.
Keep the cage mass under 0.3 g, so that it does not drain the mainspring.

origin.note: Abraham-Louis Breguet patents the tourbillon on 26 June 1801.

adoptions.via: Breguet fits the tourbillon to a pocket watch to cancel the error that gravity causes in the upright position.
